Lercanidipine, a newer-generation calcium channel blocker, is recognized for its effective antihypertensive properties and reduced side effects. A Survival Case of High-Dose Amlodipine Intoxication With Unusual Manifestation of Type 2 Respiratory Failure. Amlodipine, a calcium channel blocker of the dihydropyridine class, is frequently used to treat high blood pressure. While overdoses are rare, they can result in significant cardiovascular compromise and, infrequently, respiratory failure.
